command: Design and execute a focused real-use pass for ◎ LENS across FIELD, generic Lens, and Scale Studio, then turn observed friction into the smallest justified follow-up changes.

surface_sequence: FIELD focused on /fold-bloom/two-dial/: open Lens → switch STRUCTURE → collapse → host selects /fold-bloom/live/ → reopen → RETURN
generic /fold-bloom/: open Lens → inspect actionable controls → DEEP LAB
Scale Studio handoff: TEXT → ATLAS projection while preserving caller identity → API RETURN
Scale Studio direct visit: inspect LAB/RETURN presentation and portable overlay duplication
method.viewport: browser smoke iframe; generic probe also retains 390px mobile regression

field.friction: RETURN restored an origin belonging to the previous object after host selection changed while Lens was collapsed.

generic.friction: Half of the ordinary-route action grid advertised transformations the host could not perform.

studio.friction: Deep Lab duplicated its own Lens controller through the portable route Toolglass and named one direct exit two ways.

delta: Focus Ring records the canonical object at entry and rebases its RETURN origin whenever the host selects a different object; Lens can no longer use RETURN to override newer host selection.
Generic route Toolglass hides OUT/IN/VIEW when no live Scale API can perform them; ordinary routes show only COPY STATE / RETURN / STUDIO.
showcase-nav suppresses the portable Lens trigger when Scale Studio already owns #lensDock and a live Scale API.
Scale Studio header and dock use the same exit label/target.
stop_condition: Ship this real-use correction. Do not add Lens features until another repeated ordinary-use deficit is observed.
